title: Sightings
empty_description: When a spotter collects one of your verified cars, you see the city, the hour and the blurred photo here.
privacy_title: What you see, and what you don't
privacy_body: You see the car, the city, the hour and the blurred photo. Never the spotter's account, notes, exact time or other spots. A name only shows when the spotter chose to share it.
not_found_description: This sighting does not exist anymore, for example because the spot or your car was deleted.
